messages:
maria_cs: FYI — customer reported a regression after the 2026-02-12 rollout. They say their long-form policy generation prompt now omits required clauses.

maria_cs: Customer provided a minimal repro and attached request_id r-0a1b2c3d. They sent the whole prompt + two example responses (before/after).

sam_ml: Can you paste the exact prompt + response? Are they hitting hosted API or Dedicated? Which model/version?

maria_cs: Hosted API. They were using "redwood-model-b" v2026-02-12 (our rollout). Prompt:
```json
{"system":"You are a policy assistant","user":"Draft a privacy policy for an app that collects emails and location. Must include data retention and opt-out instructions."}
```
Response (customer):
"...includes data retention but no opt-out paragraph..."

sam_ml: Thanks. Quick note: our internal evals (policy_evals_v2) passed on canonical prompts. The customer's prompt is longer / multi-role. Could be a role-handling regression.

nate_eng: Also please attach request logs (tokenization, kernel choice). deploy-bot: route-change applied for model-b:v2 on 2026-02-12 03:04 UTC per change ch-5543.

maria_cs: Attached logs (s3://redwood-escalations/9876/r-0a1b2c3d.log). Request shows model_b:v2, temp=0.2, max_tokens=700, truncated=false, latency=210ms. No error codes.

sam_ml: I attempted a quick repro in canary with the exact prompt against model_b:v2 — I can reproduce the missing opt-out about 40% of the runs. model_b:v1 returns the opt-out reliably. Suspect alignment-tuning / prompt-handling change.

sam_ml: Hypotheses:
- formatting/role merging changed (system content being truncated/merged into user)
- decoding defaults or stop-token handling changed during rollout

jamie_product: Did we change default decode params in the rollout? Product didn't intend to alter sampling/stop defaults.

nate_eng: We flipped a "truncate_trailing_system" flag in the same rollout to improve throughput. That could affect multi-role prompts if system tokens are trimmed.

sam_ml: That aligns. Repro plan:
- run diagnostic eval: run customer's prompt set (n=50) across model_b:v1 and v2 with identical decode params
- compare exact-match for an "opt-out" clause
- inspect token streams for premature EOS / stop tokens

maria_cs: Customer asked for ETA and whether we can rollback for them — they're running trials in prod.

nate_eng: We can create a routing override to pin acct 9876 to model_b:v1 for 24h if needed. Will wait for ML confirmation before applying.

sam_ml: Running diag now, will post results. If confirmed, recommend rollback or remove the offending stop token.

sam_ml: DIAG RESULTS (summary): v1 exact-match 92%, v2 exact-match 54% on customer prompt set (n=50). v2 runs frequently end generation earlier.

sam_ml: Token inspection shows premature EOS in many v2 samples. Could be allowed stop tokens / tokenizer change. Nate, can you check token-level logs for r-0a1b2c3d?

nate_eng: Found token stream variance. For v2 many traces include the sequence and then  token at index ~112. The rollout patch modified "allowed_stop_tokens" for the family; looks like it included the empty string marker inadvertently.

sam_ml: Confirmed root cause: rollout updated allowed_stop_tokens and accidentally allowed a token that the model emits during templates, causing early termination.

maria_cs: Can we hotfix? Customer needs immediate fix.

nate_eng: I'll push a config patch to remove the empty-token from allowed_stop_tokens for model_b:v2. ETA ~20m. If needed we'll route acct 9876 to v1 temporarily.

deploy-bot: deploy started for config/model_b/v2 - change-id ch-5543-rollback

maria_cs: Notifying customer: "We identified the cause and are patching the rollout; expect restored behavior within 30 minutes."

sam_ml: Post-patch DIAG: v2 exact-match 90% (n=50). Behavior matches v1. Closing the urgent loop.

jamie_product: Please include a customer-facing summary and a recommendation on credits. Also add checklist item to rollout doc to verify stop-token diffs.

maria_cs: Will follow up on credits and file a short postmortem. Thanks everyone :heart:
